title: Kestrel and the Cover
author: E. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Yara Okafor, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
